title: When More Objectives Make Identification Easier: The Role of Preferences and Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.18577v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Best-arm identification (BAI) aims to identify the optimal arm using as few samples as possible. While most existing work focuses on a single objective, many real-world applications involve multiple criteria, which motivates the study of BAI in multi-objective bandits. Intuitively, multi-objective identification seems harder, since the learner must identify optimal arms in a higher-dimensional reward space; however, the additional objectives also provide richer feedback that can reduce the required exploration. In this paper, we characterize when and why multiple objectives can make BAI easier. For Gaussian bandits, we establish a characteristic-time lower bound for fixed-confidence identification that holds uniformly across preference orders. translated_title: 当更多目标使识别变得更容易：偏好与反馈的作用
translated_abstract: 最优臂识别（BAI）旨在使用尽可能少的样本来识别最优臂。虽然现有工作大多关注单一目标，但许多现实世界中的应用涉及多个准则，这促使了对多目标老虎机中最优臂识别的研究。直观上，多目标识别似乎更难，因为学习者必须在更高维度的奖励空间中识别最优臂；然而，额外的目标也提供了更丰富的反馈，可以减少所需的探索。在本文中，我们刻画了多个目标何时以及为何能够使最优臂识别变得更容易。对于高斯老虎机，我们建立了固定置信度识别下对所有偏好序一致成立的特征时间下界。通过在帕累托偏好、线性偏好和字典序偏好下的显式比较，我们揭示了三种现象：（i）识别一个更大的最优集合可能比识别唯一的最优臂需要更少的样本……
tldr: 本文刻画了多目标老虎机中最优臂识别何时以及为何会更简单，通过建立固定置信度下的特征时间下界，并比较帕累托、线性与字典序偏好结构，揭示了额外目标提供的更丰富反馈可以减少探索所需的样本量。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when and why multiple objectives can make best-arm identification easier in multi-objective bandits, establishing a characteristic-time lower bound for fixed-confidence identification and revealing through comparisons of Pareto, linear, and lexicographic preferences that richer feedback from additional objectives can reduce required exploration.
